title: Processing Frozen Human Blood Samples for SQK-LSK114 Oxford Nanopore DNA Sequencing
author: Abigail Miano-Burkhardt
materials: Blood samples
Water bath
Nanobind HT 1mL Blood Kit
Isopropyl alcohol (IPA)
Qubit Flex Fluorometer
Agilent Tapestation 4200
Agilent Femto Pulse System
Elution: 200 µL Buffer EB Plate
2000 µL Buffer CW2 Plate
CW1 Wash: 2000 µL Buffer CW1 Plate
Nanobind storage: 5mm Nanobind Disks Plate
Let samples rest overnight at room temperature (RT).
Following overnight rest, pipette mix samples 10x.
Part 6: Shearing (~3 hours for 8 samples)
Use Short Fragment Buffer (Part B
Mix thoroughly by gently flicking the tube or very gently pipetting up and down 10x, and then spin down.
Using a Thermocycler, incubate samples at 20 °C for 00:05:00 and then 65 °C for 00:05:00 . Note: Start and pause Thermocycler to allow lid to come to 85 °C before putting samples in.
Resuspend the AMPure XP beads by vortexing.
Transfer DNA samples to clean 1.5mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Add 60 µL (or equivalent volume, see
of resuspended beads to the reaction and mix by flicking the tube 10x. Do not pipette mix here as beads may clump around the pipette tip.
Incubate on a rocking laboratory shaker or hula mixer for 00:05:00 at RT.
Prepare 500 µL per sample of fresh 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water.
Spin down and pellet sample on magnet until eluate is clear and colorless, about 00:02:00
Keep the tube on the magnet and pipette off the supernatant. Note: Can retain if needed just in case the final elution quantification is uncharacteristically low.

With the samples remaining on the magnet, wash the beads with 200 µL of 80% EtOH, pipetting on the opposite wall making sure not to disturb the pellet. Once EtOH has been added to all samples, immediately remove and discard the EtOH. Note: The goal here is to make sure the beads are fully covered. If initial volume of beads was significantly higher than 60uL, more EtOH may be required.
Spin down and place the tube back on the magnet, pipetting off any residual EtOH.
Allow to dry for ~ 00:00:30 but do not overdry to the point of cracking.

Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and resuspend the pellet in 62 µL nuclease-free water. Incubate for 00:03:00 at RT, gently flicking every so often. If not quantifying the sample post-DNA repair and end-prep, user can resuspend the pellet in 60uL water.
Spin down and pellet the samples on a magnet until eluate is clear and colorless.

steps.title: Thaw Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw blood samples from -80°C freezer in a water bath at 37°C.

substeps.instruction: For 6mL tubes: thaw for 15 minutes.
For 1mL samples: thaw until warm (~5 minutes).

steps.title: Prepare Blood Aliquots
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix blood by inverting 10x immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: If sample volume is >1 mL, aliquot 1 mL into 1.5mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tubes.
Keep aliquots frozen at -80°C until use to limit freeze/thaw cycles.

steps.title: Set Up KingFisher Apex Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare KingFisher 24 deep well plates using Nanobind HT 1mL Blood Kit (102-762-800) as follows:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (Elution): 200 µL Buffer EB
Plate 2 (CW2 Wash 1): 2000 µL Buffer CW2
Plate 3 (CW2 Wash 2): 2000 µL Buffer CW2
Plate 4 (CW1 Wash): 2000 µL Buffer CW1
Plate 5 (Nanobind storage): 5mm Nanobind Disks
Plate 6 (Lysis Binding): Add in this order: 100 µL Proteinase K, 1000 µL Whole Blood, 100 µL RNase A, then 750 µL Buffer BL3 (add BL3 gently against the side of the well)
Plate 7 (Comb tip): 24 Flex tip comb

steps.title: Run DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Execute the 1mL_Blood_Nanobind_HT_APEX script (102-998-100) on the KingFisher Apex.

substeps.instruction: When the program pauses (after ~50 minutes), gently add 1500 µL isopropyl alcohol (IPA) against the side of the well in the lysis binding plate.
When the program ends (~1 hour 45 minutes from start), transfer eluate to a 1.5mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Use a P200 pipette to remove any remaining elution buffer from the nanobind disk.

steps.title: Store and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Allow DNA to rest overnight at room temperature (RT).

substeps.instruction: Store DNA at 4°C for up to four weeks or -80°C indefinitely.
Quantify DNA using a single measurement on the Qubit Flex Fluorometer.
Size DNA on the Agilent TapeStation 4200 or Agilent Femto Pulse System (expected size >80kb).
If recovery is <5ug, repeat extraction with 2 x 1 mL of sample; pool if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare for Size Selection
steps.instruction: Ensure samples are between 40-150ng/uL (dilute with TE buffer or water if >150ng/uL).

substeps.instruction: Start a microcentrifuge at 10,000 x g and 25°C for 5 minutes.
Place 6ug to 20ug of DNA into a 1.5mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Perform Size Selection
steps.instruction: Use the PacBio Short Read Eliminator Kit (102-208-300) to remove short fragments.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Buffer SRE to each sample and mix by flicking.
Centrifuge tubes at 10,000 x g for 30 minutes at 25°C, ensuring the hinge faces out to form the pellet on the outer wall.
For Set 1 (first 8 tubes): Centrifuge for 30 mins, then carefully remove supernatant by pipetting from the opposite side of the hinge.
For Set 2 (second 8 tubes): Centrifuge for an additional 5 mins at 10,000 x g, then remove supernatant.
Carefully add 200 µL of fresh 70% EtOH to the opposite side of the hinge wall (do not mix).
Centrifuge Set 1 for 5 mins at 10,000 x g (25°C), then carefully remove EtOH wash.
Centrifuge Set 2 for 5 mins at 10,000 x g (25°C), then carefully remove EtOH wash.
Add 50-100uL of Buffer EB and incubate at RT for 20 minutes, then flick to mix.

steps.title: Post-Size Selection Quantification
steps.instruction: Analyze recoveries via Qubit; gently pipette mix 10x if necessary to homogenize.

steps.title: Shear DNA
steps.instruction: Use the Diagenode Megaruptor 3 Shearing Kit (E07010003).

substeps.instruction: Adjust sample to 150 µL and 40-70ng/uL using TE Buffer or water (if concentration is >70ng/uL but diluting to 150uL drops it below 70ng/uL, dilute to 100uL instead; if <70ng/uL, do not dilute).
Attach the Megaruptor 3 shearing syringe to the tube and place in MR3 slots (balance samples using empty tubes if needed).
Shear twice at speed 20 (~3 hours for 150uL volume).
Remove sample and syringe; use a P200 to aspirate any leftover sample on the syringe.
Mix by gently flicking and spinning down; do not vortex.

steps.title: Post-Shear Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify on Qubit and size using Agilent TapeStation 4200 or Femto Pulse (target 30kb, observed 30-70kb).

substeps.instruction: Ensure at least 2.5 µg of DNA is available for library prep.
Store DNA at 4°C (up to 4 weeks) or -80°C indefinitely.

steps.title: Ligation Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the library using Oxford Nanopore Ligation Sequencing Kit V14 (SQK-LSK114).

substeps.instruction: Spin down Ligation Adapter (LA) and NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase; keep on ice.
Thaw Ligation Buffer (LNB) at RT, mix by pipetting, and place on ice.
Thaw Elution Buffer (EB) and Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) at RT, vortex, spin down, and place on ice.
In a 1.5mL DNA LoBind tube, mix: 60 µL DNA sample, 25 µL LNB, 10 µL Quick T4, and 5 µL LA.
Gently pipette mix, spin down, and incubate for 10 minutes at RT.
Add 45 µL of resuspended AMPure XP beads, mix by flicking, and incubate on a shaker for 5 minutes at RT.
Pellet beads on magnet and pipette off supernatant.
Wash beads twice: add 250 µL SFB, resuspend by flicking, pellet on magnet, and discard supernatant.
Dry beads for ~30 seconds (do not overdry).
Resuspend pellet in 26 µL EB, spin down, and incubate for 20 minutes at 37°C and 300-450 x g.
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear; remove 26 µL of eluate (DNA library) into a clean LoBind tube.
Quantify 2uL on Qubit; if <540ng, re-prep from Part 6.

steps.title: Prime and Load Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Prime and load an R10.4.1 flow cell (FLO-PRO114M).

substeps.instruction: Thaw SB, LIS/LIB, FCT, and FCF at RT; vortex and spin down.
Prepare priming mix: Add 30 µL FCT to 1170 µL FCF (or 30 µL FCT directly to FCF tube) and vortex.
Flush 500 µL of priming mix into inlet port 1 (avoid air bubbles) and wait 5 minutes.
Prepare library mix: 100 µL SB, 68 µL LIS/LIB, and 32 µL DNA library (adjusted to 180ng using EB).
Repeat priming flush (500 µL) and wait 5 minutes.
Gently pipette mix the library mix and load 200 µL into inlet port 1.
Close valve, close PromethION door, wait 10 minutes, and initiate sequencing.

steps.title: Wash and Reload Flow Cell
steps.instruction: Reload the flow cell as needed (e.g., every 24-48 hours).

substeps.instruction: Prepare wash mix: Add 2 µL WMX (spun, not vortexed) to 398 µL DIL (vortexed) and pipette mix.
Pause run, remove waste from port 2 or 3, and load 400 µL wash mix into inlet port 1 (avoid air).
Wait 1 hour, then repeat priming and loading steps.

steps.title: Flush and Recycle Flow Cells
steps.instruction: Clean flow cells for return after sequencing is complete.

substeps.instruction: Place absorbent material to collect 4 mL of waste.
Flush 1 mL of DI water into inlet port 1; repeat 4 times total (4 mL).
Remove liquid from waste port, return flow cells to original packaging, and ship back to Nanopore.
